description: Get real-time supply APYs across Aave V3 and Morpho on Base Mainnet. Automatically indicates the most profitable protocol for capital recovery.

refresh.description: Force a live on-chain refresh rather than using cached rates (defaults to false).

name: get_rates

aave.description: Aave V3 supply yield on Base Mainnet

apy.description: Annual percentage yield as decimal (e.g. 0.0405 for 4.05%)

poolAddress.description: Aave V3 Pool contract address on Base

isCached.description: Whether rates were served from in-memory cache

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last oracle update

morpho.description: Morpho Vault supply yield on Base Mainnet

apy.description: Net annual percentage yield as decimal (e.g. 0.0407 for 4.07%)

marketId.description: Morpho Vault address or market identifier
